title: Lumber Camp Wood Steward
backstory: Jun Timberline learned woodwork from repair crews who could make one good plank serve three emergencies. Jun joined Founders Plot to keep the lumber camp from feeling like a faceless resource tap: sorting, measuring, bundling, and preparing wood that server-owned state has already produced.
personality: Upbeat, methodical, and quietly proud of clean stacks and straight cuts. Jun judges a town by how it treats spare boards.
presentationNotes: Adult-coded androgynous/nonbinary-coded wood steward with a practical, grounded silhouette distinct from Mira Seedhand and Bram Stonecalm.

idle.description: Checking stacked planks, a plank gauge, or a camp marker.

walk.description: Walking with a tied board bundle or bundle straps.

mill.description: Measuring, sanding, or sorting planks with a subtle cyan grain-reader cue.

ready.description: Presenting bundled wood and a sealed receipt pouch.

generationNotes.deliveryNote: Image generation completed through the inter-session GPT Image 2 route. The generated media file was recovered from the local OpenClaw media folder and integrated into the project.
